meta.title: Task progress
meta.description: Shows the running task's progress bar, this turn's nodes and the remaining-time range; hover a node for its percentage, duration and finish time. Node size and four node colors are configurable, crowded nodes group together, rescaling is recorded, and the Right Sidebar keeps the finished node history and total duration. Progress comes from the model's own reports, with a side-channel evaluator filling in when needed.
